headline: Over 8 migrants found de@d and 90 rescued from boat off Spanish coast
label: NEWS
caption:
Tragedy strikes again on the dangerous migration routes into Europe 🌊

According to Firstpost, more than 8 migrants were found de@d and 90 others were rescued from a boat off Spain's Atlantic coast.

Rescue teams and authorities responded to the distressed vessel in the Atlantic Ocean.

Investigations and aid efforts are currently underway for the survivors.

What more can be done to stop these tragedies at sea? 👇
